title: TabPFN-2.5 + Stacked ET-Calibrated Ensemble for NBA Brier Target <0.215

proposals.title: TabPFN-2.5 on NBA dataset (Colab T4)
proposals.rationale: TabPFN-2.5 (Prior-Labs/tabpfn_2_5, Nature 2024) now handles up to 100K rows × 2000 features — our dataset (~1000 games × 200 selected features) is a perfect fit. Prior TabPFN v1 was limited to ~1000 rows. TabPFN-2.5 delivers calibrated Bayesian inference with no hyperparameter tuning. Competitor studies report Brier ~0.199 with calibrated models on similar datasets.
proposals.effort: LOW (pip install tabpfn, swap model, ~30min Colab)
proposals.action: In next Colab session: pip install tabpfn; from tabpfn import TabPFNClassifier; fit on train split; predict_proba for Brier. Compare to TabICL baseline 0.21514.

proposals.title: ExtraTrees + Venn-Abers calibration stacked ensemble
proposals.rationale: Fleet best non-GPU model: S17 ET top_performer 0.22084 (gen795). S18 ET best_brier 0.22248. S22 venn_abers_fusion fleet record 0.22073. Stacking ET + Venn-Abers calibration in a single model not yet attempted. Venn-Abers is mondrian conformal predictor — guarantees calibration under distribution shift (ideal for NBA season where team quality shifts).
proposals.platform: HF Space (inject via /api/config or new island)
proposals.action: Add ExtraTrees+VennAbers as a first-class model_type in features/engine.py GA. Inject into S22 when it restarts.

proposals.title: AutoGluon Tabular on NBA (Kaggle P100)
proposals.rationale: AutoGluon achieved 77.38% accuracy (Brier ~0.22) in comparative evaluations — competitive with SVM at 77.49%. AutoGluon's automatic stacking and ensembling may discover combinations our GA hasn't found. Kaggle P100 has AutoGluon available.
proposals.action: Update nba_karpathy_loop.py to include AutoGluon TabularPredictor as a baseline comparison.

proposals.title: Temporal/schedule features: home_next + rest_mismatch
proposals.rationale: MDPI 2026 study: 'home_next' (has team played home game next?) is the #1 most influential feature across multiple models. Our engine has rest/schedule category but may not have forward-looking 'home_next' or 'opponent_rest_mismatch_days'. These are zero-cost to compute from existing schedule data.
proposals.effort: LOW (add 2-3 features to engine.py cat 6 REST_SCHEDULE)
proposals.action: Add home_next_game_home (bool), next_game_days_gap, opponent_next_game_home to features/engine.py category 6.

proposals.title: Rotation C: Inject ExtraTrees preference into political islands
proposals.rationale: ExtraTrees dominates NBA (S17+S18 both ET, best Brier). Political islands use xgboost/catboost/lightgbm. ET's random feature subspace sampling may reduce noise from high-cardinality political event features. P7 xgboost_brier 0.24994 is live best — ET injection via /api/command may escape current plateau.
proposals.action: Next brain cycle: POST /api/command {"action": "inject_model", "model_type": "extra_trees"} to P7/P5. If endpoint not available, add extra_trees to political island mutation pool via PR.
